verdict.rationale: Cognee ships a documented MCP server that lets multiple off-the-shelf AI assistants (Claude, Cursor, Cline, Continue, Codex) connect to and share the same underlying memory/knowledge graph, directly matching the 'shared memory across tools' story. missing for 10: explicit mention of ChatGPT as a supported client, and any independent/hands-on report confirming multi-tool memory sharing actually works in practice.
